headline: 2 million+ beneficiaries: New pay scale for govt employees to be implemented in 4 phases
summary: The Ministry of Finance is recommending a phased increase in salaries and allowances for government officials and pensioners, with a gazette expected by mid-September.
details: The Ministry of Finance is set to recommend a new pay scale for government employees and pensioners, which may be implemented in four distinct phases across two fiscal years.
The recommendations are expected to be presented at the cabinet meeting on Monday afternoon, August 31, for final approval.
The proposed plan suggests that 30% of the basic salary increase will take effect from July 1 of the current fiscal year, followed by another 35% at the start of the next year.
The remaining portion of the basic salary and subsequent allowances, including house rent, will be implemented in the following fiscal year's July and January respectively.
The government is finalizing the pay scale while maintaining the existing 20-grade system, although employees have requested a reduction in the number of grades to avoid disparities.
Over 2 million people, including current employees and pensioners, are expected to benefit from this new salary structure.
The strategy of phased implementation is intended to manage economic pressures caused by ongoing global conflicts and to fund the increases through internal resource mobilization.
caption:
Over 2 million government employees and pensioners are set for a salary hike. A new 4-phase pay scale is heading to the cabinet for approval.

The Ministry of Finance is set to recommend a new pay scale for government employees and pensioners, which may be implemented in four distinct phases across two fiscal years.

The recommendations are expected to be presented at the cabinet meeting on Monday afternoon, August 31, for final approval.

The proposed plan suggests that 30% of the basic salary increase will take effect from July 1 of the current fiscal year, followed by another 35% at the start of the next year.

The remaining portion of the basic salary and subsequent allowances, including house rent, will be implemented in the following fiscal year's July and January respectively.

The government is finalizing the pay scale while maintaining the existing 20-grade system, although employees have requested a reduction in the number of grades to avoid disparities.

Over 2 million people, including current employees and pensioners, are expected to benefit from this new salary structure.

The strategy of phased implementation is intended to manage economic pressures caused by ongoing global conflicts and to fund the increases through internal resource mobilization.

headline_marked: Friendship founder [[Runa Khan wins Ramon Magsaysay Award]]
headline: Friendship founder Runa Khan wins Ramon Magsaysay Award
summary: The award recognizes her lifelong commitment to serving marginalized communities and empowering the underprivileged to shape their own futures.
details: Runa Khan, the founder and executive director of the non-governmental organization Friendship, has been honored with the prestigious Ramon Magsaysay Award, often referred to as Asia's Nobel Prize.
The Ramon Magsaysay Award Foundation announced the winners for 2026 in Manila, Philippines, on Monday, August 31.

Khan was selected for the award based on her leadership and dedication to serving humanity, creating opportunities for marginalized people, and empowering the underprivileged to build their own futures.
Along with Runa Khan, two other individuals—Tommy Koh of Singapore and Bo Chi of Myanmar—have also received the award this year.
The award is presented on the 119th birth anniversary of the Philippines' seventh president, Ramon Magsaysay, in its 68th edition.
The formal honor will be presented to the winners on November 15 at the Metropolitan Theater in Manila.
Established in 1957 to preserve the memory of President Ramon Magsaysay, the foundation has been awarding this prize since 1958.
While the award previously had six specific categories, since 2009, most of these categories have been open to a broader range of recipients.
caption:
A Bangladeshi leader is honored with 'Asia's Nobel Prize'.

Runa Khan, the founder and executive director of the non-governmental organization Friendship, has been honored with the prestigious Ramon Magsaysay Award, often referred to as Asia's Nobel Prize.

The Ramon Magsaysay Award Foundation announced the winners for 2026 in Manila, Philippines, on Monday, August 31.

Khan was selected for the award based on her leadership and dedication to serving humanity, creating opportunities for marginalized people, and empowering the underprivileged to build their own futures.

Along with Runa Khan, two other individuals—Tommy Koh of Singapore and Bo Chi of Myanmar—have also received the award this year.

The award is presented on the 119th birth anniversary of the Philippines' seventh president, Ramon Magsaysay, in its 68th edition.

The formal honor will be presented to the winners on November 15 at the Metropolitan Theater in Manila.

Established in 1957 to preserve the memory of President Ramon Magsaysay, the foundation has been awarding this prize since 1958.

While the award previously had six specific categories, since 2009, most of these categories have been open to a broader range of recipients.
